newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Export demand keeps offers up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Export demand keeps offers up.

text.p: Soymeal basis levels were mostly steady to higher on Monday as strong export demand continued to bolster prices, several cash brokers said.
"You can't even find meal out there right now," one broker said. "These prices are just so attractive in the export market that they're just gobbling up everything we have."
Offers jumped $4.00 to $5.00 per ton in parts of Illinois, Alabama, Ohio and Pennsylvania.
"Processors are crushing it hard but they're exporting it hard, too," a Tennessee broker said. "I heard November is going to be tight as well."
Several western Midwest areas made good harvest progress over the weekend, but brokers in the eastern Corn Belt said persistent light showers stalled progress.
